title: Flour gets costlier as imports stay insufficient
summary: KARACHI: Amid a persistent shortfall, the arrival of imported wheat has so far failed to bring any relief to consumers, as wheat and wheat flour prices continue to rise. So far, more than 100,000 tonnes of wheat have arrived in the country since the last week of October.
